author: NASS
description:
I colorized, restored, and sound-designed this rare footage, offering a valuable glimpse into everyday life in Bretagne around 1920, featuring Quimper, Douarnenez, Audierne, Plogoff, Brest at a pivotal moment when the region was emerging from the aftermath of the First World War, balancing long-standing maritime and rural traditions with the slow arrival of modernity, as fishing ports, markets, and coastal towns reflected both resilience and continuity in the daily lives of Breton communities.

00:06-02:14 Quimper
02:14-03:47 Douarnenez
03:48-06:34 Audierne
06:35-09:46 Plogoff
09:47-12:56 Brest

🛠️ Video Restoration Process:
✔ FPS boosted to 60 frames per second
✔ Image resolution enhanced up to HD quality
✔ Improved video sharpness and brightness
✔ Colorization using 51 manually colorized keyframes to establish accurate ambiance and color consistency (not historically accurate)
✔ Sound design created for immersive atmosphere
